summary: Build golden retrieval test set: fixture pinned to v3 snapshot with corpus_version + precision/recall scorer; 15-25 queries, semi-auto-labeled, human-ratified

resolution.note: Corpus-pinned golden gate (corpus_version 27): 14 asserted queries — tradition-anchored (distinctive term -> certain tradition: taoism/jewish_mysticism/neoplatonism/hermeticism/egyptian/gnosticism/sufism) + hierarchy/breadth (minConcepts/minTraditions). Labels are domain-knowledge, not system output (non-circular). Calibrated live: 14/14 pass. 2 cases (Ahura Mazda->zoroastrianism, Tiamat->mesopotamian) surfaced a real gap, moved to documented knownGaps + filed as debt 31a7fe76 (not asserted, would be a red baseline). INTEGRATION_TEST-gated, skips in CI. This is the relevance gate for weight-tuning + future big retrieval changes.
